up: Find all unique compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725229'. Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), and canonical SMILES. Join docs (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725229') with compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Return distinct rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725229'
